notes.text: The linked Gemara says that Levi bar Darga paid thirteen thousand gold dinars to redeem his daughter. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2360&lang=en) cites this same episode and expresses uncertainty about whether Levi was a sage.
